LanguageData.RatkinQL_ContractTree_Report: A wandering Ratkin merchant offered a supply contract.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_Greeting: Ah, {Interviewer_labelShort}. Heard your larders are well-stocked. How about this — you front me thirty pemmican, I run a trade route, and send the coin back in two drops. Your cut plus a ten-percent commission. Sound fair?
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_OptAccept: Accept the deal — hand over 30 pemmican.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_OptTerms: Tell me how this contract works.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_Terms1: First payment comes by drop pod in about ten days, the second a week after that.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_Terms2: We Ratkin guilds take our word seriously — nobody in ZHP welches on a sealed handshake.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_Terms3: You get the whole cargo price plus an extra ten-percent commission. Fair for fair trade.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_Farewell: Good doing business with you. May your storerooms stay full.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_MsgAccept: You handed over thirty pemmican and sealed the Ratkin supply contract with a firm pawshake. The merchant shouldered the bundle and set off down the road.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Contract_MsgSealed: The Ratkin merchant has departed with your pemmican. Two drop pod shipments of silver are scheduled to arrive — the first in about ten days, the second a week later.
